agreed_basis: Every finding from rounds 1-3 (22 in total, from both families) is fixed and independently re-measured by the author before commit. Round 4's claude-family lane returned implement-as-written with no blocker. The round-4 gemini lane did NOT run: the agy account quota was exhausted (429), which is a capacity fact and not a review outcome, and it is recorded here rather than papered over. Both families are represented across the review as a whole, per S5.
residuals: The narrowing [graph] key list is maintained by hand against a tool that adds keys; the contract's scope_limit says so.

A #[cfg(test)] gate now ships in the published crate and reads repo files, so a vendored tarball that runs cargo test goes red on 2026-10-20 about ruchy's own ledger. Documented trade-off: the alternative is the fail-open shape the gate exists to refuse.
The round-4 second-family lane is unrun. Re-dispatchable after the agy quota resets.
artifact_location_note: pmat-merge reads docs/audits/quorum-<ticket>.json and excludes that path from the judged diff, so a commit that only adds the verdict leaves the diff unchanged. A copy under .quorum/ is NOT excluded and would perturb its own judged diff, refusing the merge it is meant to arm. Recorded because the operator asked for .quorum/: that is forjar committed-quorum territory, and here the gate reads docs/audits/.
rebind_note: Rebound after a roadmap-valid fix: four ticket descriptions containing ": " were stored by pmat as acceptance_criteria and parsed by YAML as maps, failing CI before cargo-audit ever ran. The verdict covers the same code; only the roadmap text changed.
